what: A photo panel drifts slowly within 10~14px on a 10.5s period with two layered sine waves (per axis big wave .58~.72·small wave .14~.24, period·phase slightly different each time it opens), and the inner photo moves .45x in reverse and is scaled up to 1.08x, giving a swaying depth inside the window. On hover it approaches the cursor by up to 18px in .10 steps, and on leave it returns to its place

options.inner: Ratio at which the inner photo moves in reverse, default .45
options.follow: Max distance (px) the element follows the cursor, default 18 — 0 means no follow
options.area: Ancestor selector that measures the cursor (e.g. a), or the element itself if none. Writes --fx-follow-x and --fx-follow-y on that ancestor so siblings such as a title strip move along with it.
options.[data-fx-part=inner]: Inner photo moving the opposite way (optional child)

note: The outer panel only uses the --fx-drift-x and --fx-drift-y variables, while the inner photo ([data-fx-part=inner]) is moved the opposite way by fx.css with the same variables (the original also moves by variables). Follow comes from the area ancestor’s --fx-follow-x·y
